summary.en: OpenAI chief scientist Jakub Pachocki has proposed in a blog post that the industry use perplexity as a common yardstick for AI progress and agree on shared limits on development. Perplexity measures how well a model predicts the next token on average, with lower numbers meaning better predictions; GPT-4 scored about 0.91, and once scores fell below 0.8, transformative capabilities emerged in areas such as cybersecurity and mathematics. Pachocki called on labs to commit not to cross a threshold until their ability to monitor AI behaviour reaches specific milestones; CEO Sam Altman publicly backed the post, calling it one of the most important things OpenAI has published in a while.

summary.en: Hong Kong's Election Committee Subsector Ordinary Elections have delivered a string of surprise upsets, even as turnout hit a record 98.79 per cent, with 5,640 of 5,709 registered voters casting ballots for 723 seats contested by 856 candidates. Law Society president Roden Tong Man-lung lost in the legal subsector, and Hong Kong General Chamber of Commerce chief executive Patrick Yeung Wai-tim won only nine votes in commercial (first). summary.en: Approved by the China Securities Regulatory Commission, the Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing stock exchanges will cut the minimum margin requirement for margin purchases from 100% to 80% from November 30, theoretically freeing about 400 billion yuan of financing capacity across the market. The Shenzhen exchange also opened public consultation on market-making rules for the ChiNext board, while both the Shanghai and Shenzhen exchanges rolled out fee cuts and extended fee waivers, including on listing fees, by two years to 2028. The margin ratio was only raised from 80% to 100% in January and is being cut back ten months later; as of November 19, total margin balances stood at 2.22 trillion yuan, a near one-year low.

summary.en: South Korea's Education Minister Choi Kyo-jin resigned on Sunday, taking responsibility for confusion caused by last-minute rule changes aimed at preventing AI-assisted cheating ahead of the national college entrance exam, and President Lee Jae Myung accepted the resignation.
